notes:
- Add Tatami and Double Tatami underlay to open Satin columns, including curved and tapered columns. Adjust stitch length, spacing, angle and inset per layer.
- Choose Standard, Borderline or Diagonal backstitch for Tatami underlay.
- Set separate start and end margins for open Satin underlay. Negative settings extend support past the selected end for an intentional overlap.
- New Satin branches with a cap-to-side join can stage all underlay before the cover when a continuous route is available.
